Container.Name: rust-server
Container.Overview:
A dedicated server for Rust, with optional Oxide (uMod) plugin support and a built-in RCON tool.
Set RCON_PASSWORD before you start the server.
Forward these ports on your router: 28015 TCP and UDP (game), 28016 TCP (RCON), and 28082 TCP (Rust+ app).
The settings in this template write over the server configuration on each start. To keep your own configuration, set GENERATE_SETTINGS to false.
To send RCON commands, run: docker exec rust-server rcon-cli "say Hello"
Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.
Container.Requires: 4 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM (more than 12 GB recommended), 20 GB storage.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: rust facepunch dedicated server steam oxide umod rcon

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Game port (TCP). Must be the same as SERVER_PORT.

Config.Name: Game Port UDP
Config.Description: Game port (UDP). Forward it on your router. Must be the same as SERVER_PORT.

Config.Name: RCON Port
Config.Description: RCON port (TCP). Must be the same as RCON_PORT.

Config.Name: RCON Port UDP
Config.Description: RCON port (UDP). Must be the same as RCON_PORT.

Config.Name: App Port
Config.Description: Rust+ companion app port (TCP). Must be the same as APP_PORT.

Config.Name: Server Files
Config.Description: Server files, game data, and configuration.

Config.Name: RCON Password
Config.Description: Required. Password for RCON access.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name of the server in the server browser.

Config.Name: Server Description
Config.Description: Description in the server browser.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of players that can connect.

Config.Name: World Size
Config.Description: Size of the map. 3000 to 6000 is recommended.

Config.Name: Server Seed
Config.Description: World generation seed. The same seed gives the same map.

Config.Name: Game Mode
Config.Description: standard, softcore, or hardcore.

Config.Name: PvP
Config.Description: Enable player-versus-player combat (true or false).

Config.Name: Server Tags
Config.Description: Comma-separated tags for the server browser, for example vanilla,monthly,pve.

Config.Name: Oxide Enabled
Config.Description: Install the Oxide (uMod) plugin framework (true or false).

Config.Name: Map Type
Config.Description: Procedural Map, Barren, HapisMountain, SavasIsland, or SavasIsland_koth.

Config.Name: Custom Map URL
Config.Description: Direct URL to a custom map file. If set, MAP_TYPE is not used.

Config.Name: Max Team Size
Config.Description: Maximum players per team. Leave empty for the server default.

Config.Name: Server Era
Config.Description: Era for primitive mode servers. Leave empty unless you run primitive mode.

Config.Name: Decay Scale
Config.Description: Structure decay scale. 0 is no decay and 1 is the default.

Config.Name: Stability
Config.Description: Enable the structure stability system (true or false).

Config.Name: Radiation
Config.Description: Enable radiation in radtowns (true or false).

Config.Name: Save Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between world saves.

Config.Name: Server Secure
Config.Description: 1 enables VAC and the public server listing. 0 is a private or sandbox server.

Config.Name: Server Encryption
Config.Description: 0 is none, 1 is weak, and 2 is strong. Some mods need a weaker setting.

Config.Name: Server Identity
Config.Description: Folder name for server data and saves. If empty, SERVER_NAME is used.

Config.Name: Server URL
Config.Description: Website URL for your server.

Config.Name: Server Header Image
Config.Description: HTTP URL of a header image for the server browser.

Config.Name: Server Logo Image
Config.Description: HTTP URL of a logo image for the server browser.

Config.Name: Startup Arguments
Config.Description: Extra arguments for RustDedicated, added after all other arguments, for example +server.tags monthly,vanilla.

Config.Name: Generate Settings
Config.Description: Apply the settings from this template on each start. Set to false to keep your own server configuration.

Config.Name: Update On Start
Config.Description: Download and validate the server files from Steam on each start. Set to false to skip.

Config.Name: Server Port
Config.Description: Game port the server listens on. Must be the same as the Game Port.

Config.Name: RCON Port Variable
Config.Description: RCON port the server listens on. Must be the same as the RCON Port.

Config.Name: App Port Variable
Config.Description: Rust+ app port the server listens on. Must be the same as the App Port.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions.
